Prepara un report di incidente di sicure: Prepare a security incident report with a professional structure: summary, scope and authorisation, timeline, evidence and IoCs, impact and recommendations. Preview, print and export to PDF or JSON.

Prepare a security incident report with the structure used by incident response teams, then print it or export it to PDF or JSON. It is an exercise in professional writing: for students, junior SOC analysts and exam candidates; beginner level, about 20 minutes.
<strong>Sintesi</strong>: cosa è success: Summary: what happened, severity and current status, in a few lines for decision-makers.
<strong>Perimetro e autorizzazione</stro: Scope and authorisation: the systems analysed, who authorised the work and within which limits.
<strong>Timeline</strong>: eventi in ord: Timeline: events in chronological order, with date, time and time zone.
<strong>Evidenze e indicatori di comprom: Evidence and indicators of compromise (IoCs): logs, hashes, addresses, domains, with the source of each item.
<strong>Raccomandazioni</strong>: azioni: Recommendations: corrective and preventive actions, one per line, with priority.
<strong>Non inserire dati personali o in: Do not enter real personal data or confidential information. Use fictitious or anonymised names, addresses and data: the PDF is generated on EVIL's server and the text travels over the network. For a real incident use the tools and channels approved by your organisation. See Privacy and terms and Ethics and law.
Es.: Phishing con furto di credenziali,: E.g. Phishing with credential theft, March 2026
Cosa è successo, quando è stato rilevato: What happened, when it was detected, severity and current status (contained, ongoing, resolved).
Sistemi e periodo analizzati, chi ha aut: Systems and period analysed, who authorised the analysis (role, date of the mandate), what was excluded.
Ogni attività di analisi deve avere un'a: Every analysis must have written authorisation: state here who gave it and within which limits.
Una riga per evento, es.: 2026-03-12 09:: One line per event, e.g.: 2026-03-12 09:14 CET — phishing email received by 3 users
Log rilevanti, hash SHA-256, domini e in: Relevant logs, SHA-256 hashes, domains and (sample) IP addresses, with the source of each item.
Per gli esempi usa i domini riservati al: For examples use the domains reserved for documentation (example.com) and the documentation IP ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24).
Effetti tecnici, sui dati (riservatezza,: Technical effects, effects on data (confidentiality, integrity, availability) and on the business.
Es.: server di posta, database clienti,: E.g. mail server, customer database, website
Una azione per riga, con priorità, es.:: One action per line, with priority, e.g.: High — enable multi-factor authentication for email
